definition.aggregateRule: Ultra-golden passes only when every required layer passes for every scoped level report. The checker deliberately does not publish a blended ultra-golden percentage.

layers.criterion: The strict level-support claim has no open strict rows, selected-identity blockers, SRD-authored product-readiness blockers, or strict final-support blockers; diagnostic product-readiness rows do not block unless promoted into that blocker set.
layers.label: Support completeness

layers.criterion: Every scoped reducer-semantic obligation is covered, and every scoped semantic-core QNT owner is generation-subset-clean with no run-block blocker.
layers.label: QNT/generator readiness

layers.criterion: Every scoped reducer-semantic obligation has at least one rules-kernel parity witness.
layers.label: MBT/parity evidence

layers.criterion: Every scoped user-facing MCP flow has checker-owned scenario evidence backed by the MCP scenario evidence command.
layers.label: MCP scenario evidence

witnessKinds.contract-test: Focused contract test evidence for checked registry joins, protocol vocabulary mappings, or boundary inventories where the executable obligation is the join itself rather than a reducer trace.
witnessKinds.deterministic-qnt-replay: Closed-case QNT replay evidence for fixed projections, scalar checks, or tiny named fixtures; not random MBT coverage.
witnessKinds.focused-mbt: Random-trace QNT/MBT parity evidence for reducer sequencing, holes, resources, active effects, reactions, or interleavings.
witnessKinds.mcp-scenario: Package-local MCP acceptance scenario evidence for user-facing tool and workflow flows.
witnessKinds.runtime-test: Focused runtime test evidence for a profile-scoped reducer or projection path that already has profile-level QNT proof ownership or declared semantic-core QNT ownership.

requiredFlows.description: The MCP server exposes discoverable tool contracts, workflow guidance, catalogs, and structured result paths before a caller commits to a character or battle workflow.
The MCP surface admits an SRD character creation workflow through create, discover, fill, and finalize tools without relying on support-profile status as scenario evidence.
The MCP surface exposes durable character sheet state and battle handoff results through list and session snapshot tools.
The MCP surface admits an SRD battle flow through start, read, discover acts, fill battle holes, resolve acts, end turns, and end battle tools.

criteria.mcpScenarioJoin: A selected-identity replay evidence row is joined to MCP when at least one required MCP flow inferred from its scoped supported profile has scenario evidence.
criteria.parityWitnessJoin: A selected-identity replay evidence row is joined to parity evidence when the same Unit has a checked parity witness for a scoped supported Unit profile.
criteria.rowPolicy: Rows list scoped supported Units whose selected-identity replay evidence exists but has neither a Unit-scoped parity witness join nor an MCP scenario-evidence flow join.
